open_closure_items.detail: Extras, Fonts, Locale and Storage disks are absent from the selected reference set; all six disks are not yet closed.
Only the M10 40.42 Install/Workbench pair is admitted; machine-specific 3.1 variants require reconciliation.
Clean installed placement, protection flags and startup/installer resident behavior have not been observed.
Installed SYS:C/MOSSYS:C assigns, search precedence, installer filtering and resulting P bits require capture.
Binary tags and template-looking strings are not runtime observations or complete option/behavior contracts.
Freeze is in the documentation index and historic 2.1 release notes, but absent from the inspected 3.20 ISO tree.
